installer-gui-script.title: BE-300 Emulator
installer-gui-script.welcome:
Installs BE-300 emulator and its VM manager into /Applications.
After installation, double-click a .be300vm package in Finder to launch that VM directly, or open BE-300 from /Applications to create new ones.
The .app is not currently code-signed. The first time you launch it, right-click the icon in Finder and choose "Open" to allow Gatekeeper to run it.
